# Sparkle 2.9.6

Official macOS universal framework, preserved with its signatures and symlinks.
Only macOS links and embeds this framework. There is no Swift Package dependency
in the shared project, so iPhone builds do not resolve or download Sparkle.

Source: https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/tree/2.9.6

Distribution: https://github.com/sparkle-project/Sparkle/releases/download/2.9.6/Sparkle-for-Swift-Package-Manager.zip

SHA-256: `8d5fb41d960b43f4a68aa14126bf62b098544ec8d191cdcc73eb14e63a8e7606`

The framework is copied from `Sparkle.xcframework/macos-arm64_x86_64/`.
The upstream license is included in LICENSE. Signing tools and debug symbols
are not shipped in Planora or committed to this directory.
